decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That this consent is granted for a period of 25 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public.
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the commencement of development a detailed lighting management plan (LMP) shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA.  No development shall be carried out until the LMP has been approved.  
The LMP shall cover the:
i) LED shroud;
ii) four advertisement screens; and
iii)  other external lighting (if any).
The LMP shall assess the impact of the lighting on:
a) highway safety; and 
b)  the amenity of:
i) residents
ii) business users
iii) public open spaces
iv) character of the area
and provide for such impacts to be mitigated. 
The LMP shall cover (without limitation):
i) lux levels/lighting intensities
ii) timing for frequency of changes of moving displays (if any) 
iii) colours
iv) hours of operation
v) the inter-operation of the shroud, four advertisement screens and other external lighting (if any) 
vi) the maintenance and operation of the shroud, four advertisement screens and other external lighting (if any).

Condition : 8 - An application for advertisement consent shall be made for any changes to the approved advertisements that alter the nature of the delivery and operation of the advertisements that are proposed as part of application ref 00505/EY/AD15 .
description: Installation of four internally illuminated advertisement screens incorporated within the elevations of the proposed office development
